summary: Full backend + frontend testing of RightTeam marketing site. All backend APIs (health, leads POST/GET, contact POST, invalid email validation) passing (4/4 pytest tests). Frontend flows tested: home, pillar tab nav, service page (GST), multi-step quote form with backend integration, contact form with backend integration, reviews, about. All flows working end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /api/leads GET converts stored ISO strings back to datetime by mutating docs during iteration — works but list_leads has no auth; acceptable for marketing site.
server.py uses @app.on_event('shutdown') which is deprecated in newer FastAPI; consider lifespan handler.
Reviews page uses reference format RT/Q/... instead of RT/F/... mentioned in request (still 'mono format' with 9 cards). Minor cosmetic — confirm intended prefix with product.
seed_data_creation: Created a few TEST_ leads and one TEST_ contact via APIs during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers health, leads CRUD, contact, email validation. All 4 tests pass. UI multi-step quote form: service select is a native <select>, business_stage is <select> (use label 'LLP / Private Limited'), state is <input>, turnover is <select>. Success screen at data-testid=quote-success shows reference number. Reviews page uses RT/Q/YYYY/NNNNN ref format.
